title: Awareness & Inclusion Night 2026
body:
Thank you to the 19 people who attended AND FC’s Awareness & Inclusion Night on Monday 26 October 2026. The evening covered bullying, racism, discrimination, respect, online safety and recognising online manipulation. Together, we explored how to recognise inappropriate behaviour, support one another and speak up when something worries us. Anyone with a concern can speak privately to Ryan Hamilton, our club welfare/safeguarding officer, or any of our coaches.

One Club. One Team. One Standard.
Ability Not Disability.
